[SOURCE_COMPONENT: kr-010860-288151-ko#amendment_reasons]
REASONS FOR AMENDMENT AND MAIN CONTENTS

[Partial amendment]

◇ Reasons for amendment and main contents

The amendment is intended to simplify the grades of environmental educators from three to two for efficient operation and management of the environmental educator qualification system and entrust the operation of continuing training for environmental educators to the National Environmental Education Center, while also improving and supplementing certain shortcomings revealed in the operation of the existing system. These improvements include bringing provisions on the procedures and methods for formulating environmental education plans into line with the amended Act, under which the heads of large cities with populations of at least 500,000 are also required to formulate environmental education plans that take account of local conditions.

<Provided by the Ministry of Government Legislation>
